name: smwmusic-mega-man-x6-infinite-possibilities-infinity-mijinion-remix
title: Mega Man X6 - Infinite Possibilities ~ Infinity Mijinion (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Infinity Mijinion's Stage theme from Mega Man X6 for Summer C3 2022. I originally did start this two months back but never got to finishing it (due to being unsatisfied with it). Luckily, I pushed through for this C3 and decided to give it the attention it deserves once again.

As a fan of The Final Countdown, Infinity Mijinion's stage theme is easily one of my favorite songs in the entire Mega Man franchise. I had to arrange this song for C3.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" is disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. F# Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. G Minor (Custom Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. Enables Voice Clip, but disables Thunder & P-Switch (turned on default)
2. Disables Voice Clip
